conclusion: Measured socket sndbuf 9.2x and rcvbuf16x, snd_wnd median 2.2-4.1x and well above single-flow 500KB BDP on B. CUBIC cwnd remains 37-45MSS and actual TCP only ~1Mbps; increasing socket/receive buffers is NOT the rate limiter. Mean about2% IID netem per run; same VM but stochastic drop pattern differs, small differences not causal improvement.
